certification_reason: Publication lag for LME warehouse stocks is the critical gate: it was not measured in phase 1 and Norgate vendor API does not provide per-bar timestamps. The director flagged this as 'MEDIUM PIT concern' and precisely the source where a lag error manufactures a false t-statistic. Until the lag is measured and pre-registered, any hypothesis using these data carries unknown observability risk. Additionally, tradable cross-section collapses to copper only (HG) with no cost data measured, making hypothesis expressibility doubtful. Data ownership and history are sound; the gate is observability and cost certification.
